RATING-AMBEST-FSR.use: Disclosed FSR → capital depth ordinal scale for capital_reinsurance.

SII-DELEG-35.title: Delegated Regulation (EU) 2015/35 — Solvency II technical standards
SII-DELEG-35.use: Standard Formula SCR modules; concentration risk in underwriting and market risk.

UK-GOV-SII-REFORM.title: Review of Solvency II — consultation response (Solvency UK)
UK-GOV-SII-REFORM.use: UK concentration and matching-adjustment reforms; long-duration liability risk margin.

STRATA-AI-INSURANCE.title: Investigating an insurance-for-AI startup
STRATA-AI-INSURANCE.use: MGA path; claims-history import pricing; GL/PI exceptions; capital efficiency via scale; checkbox underwriting workflow.

MCKINSEY-MGA.title: Managing general agents: An emerging model in commercial P&C insurance
MCKINSEY-MGA.use: MGA economics: management fee vs profit commission; paper risk when reinsurer pulls capacity.

MUNICHRE-GENAI-WP.title: Insuring Generative AI: Risks and Mitigation Strategies
MUNICHRE-GENAI-WP.use: aiSure performance guarantees; GenAI underwriting (task-scoped metrics, continuous monitoring, foundation-model drift); environmental/training energy risk; maps to product_fit, pricing_modelling, data_monitoring for munich-re.

ACAD-AI-ENERGY-DCC.authors: Liu, M.; Huang, J.; Liu, S.
ACAD-AI-ENERGY-DCC.title: Artificial intelligence assets and energy markets: Risk correlation dynamics and determinants
ACAD-AI-ENERGY-DCC.use: AI–clean energy mean DCC ~0.67; AI hedges gas/INE, diversifies WTI/Brent; CPU/DRV/EPU strengthen correlations; regional crude heterogeneity; maps to aggregation_correlation and RDS stress.

ACAD-CRI-GRID-SRI.authors: Che-Castaldo, J. P.; Cousin, R.; Daryanto, S.; et al.
ACAD-CRI-GRID-SRI.title: Critical Risk Indicators (CRIs) for the electric power grid: a survey and discussion of interconnected effects
ACAD-CRI-GRID-SRI.use: Multi-domain CRIs (climate, finance, hydrology, ecology, space weather) → grid interruption; SAIDI/SAIFI/reserve margin; Systemic Risk Indicators via VAR/Granger networks; power interruption as risk realisation; maps to register-based sub-factors and aggregation_correlation.

INSTECH-NDBI-PARAMETRIC.title: Intact but interrupted: parametric solutions for non-damage business interruption
INSTECH-NDBI-PARAMETRIC.use: NDBI market survey; parametric for interruption without damage; trigger_gap and product_fit anchor.

EPIC-DC-ENERGY-RISK.title: Managing the Next Energy Risk Curve — data centres
EPIC-DC-ENERGY-RISK.use: Grid curtailment as core NDBI; parametric utility triggers; energy dependency underwriting for DC.

DESCARTES-DC-PARAMETRIC.title: Parametric product suite for data centres
DESCARTES-DC-PARAMETRIC.use: Up to $140M parametric; NDBI/DSU/behind-meter; peril-index triggers; product_fit for descartes-underwriting entity.

MGA-PARAMETRIX-SLA.title: SLA insurance for data centres
MGA-PARAMETRIX-SLA.use: Lloyd's coverholder parametric SLA mirror; telemetry monitoring; trigger_gap=0 design; triple-net financing.

OFGEM-DEMAND-REFORM.title: Demand Connections Reform — Call for Input (Curate / Plan / Connect)
OFGEM-DEMAND-REFORM.use: ~125 GW demand queue vs ~45 GW peak; ~50 GW DC; 81% open to non-firm; Connect Operate pillar may mandate flex conditions.

ACAD-NONFIRM-REVIEW.authors: Monterde, R.; Alvarez, E. F.; Valarezo, O.
ACAD-NONFIRM-REVIEW.title: Non-Firm Grid Connections: A Review of Access Types, Mechanisms, and Regulatory Frameworks
ACAD-NONFIRM-REVIEW.use: Four models: capacity-limited, time-limited, DOEs, fully flexible ANM; UK Flexible Plug and Play (87% cost / 57% lead-time); curtailment predictability spectrum → trigger_gap; LIFO/pro-rata → compound loss; reviews UK/ES/DE/BE/AU/EU/US frameworks.

ACAD-FLEX-CONN-HCA.title: The Role of Flexible Connection in Accelerating Load Interconnection in Distribution Networks
ACAD-FLEX-CONN-HCA.use: Flexibility-aware hosting capacity; infrequent utility interventions unlock load capacity; distribution-level infirm connection economics → frequency_duration at low N.

INDUSTRY-DC-FLEX-PRINCETON.title: Flexible Data Center Whitepaper — conditional firm service and BYOC
INDUSTRY-DC-FLEX-PRINCETON.use: Conditional firm vs non-firm; transmission constraint vs generation curtailment distinction; compute flexibility + on-site resources → utilisation_compute channel.

ACAD-DC-SITING-FLEX.authors: Kim, D.; Dong, L.; Xie, L.
ACAD-DC-SITING-FLEX.title: Flexibility-aware framework for efficient planner-initiated siting of data center
ACAD-DC-SITING-FLEX.use: Firm/pause/shift envelopes expand DC siting frontier; connection_stage and utilisation_compute — workload shift vs full curtailment.

ACAD-DC-STCU-FLEX.title: Data Center Spatio-Temporal Load Flexibility in Security-Constrained Unit Commitment
ACAD-DC-STCU-FLEX.use: Temporal/spatial load shifting reduces renewable curtailment; capacity derating within day — utilisation not binary off.

EU-DIRECTIVE-FLEX-ACCESS.title: Directive (EU) 2024/1711 — common rules for the internal market in electricity
EU-DIRECTIVE-FLEX-ACCESS.use: Member States must support flexible/non-firm grid connections where capacity is scarce; EU-wide anchor cited in Monterde et al. 2025 review.

SP-HYPERSCALE-INSURABLE-POOL.title: Data Centers Offer A Hyperscale Pool Of Insurable Risks
SP-HYPERSCALE-INSURABLE-POOL.use: ~$2tn insurable base; PML/MFL layered limits not full TIV; ~$10bn premium runway; aggregation on multiphase campuses.

SWISS-RE-DATA-CENTRE-AI.title: sigma insights 07/2026: Insuring AI — data centre value accumulation risks
SWISS-RE-DATA-CENTRE-AI.use: Split-program opacity; nat-cat accumulation on DC; liquid cooling ~24% loss costs; premiums $10.6bn→$24.2bn by 2030.

AON-DCLP.title: Data Center Lifecycle Insurance Program (DCLP)
AON-DCLP.use: $3.5bn CAR/DSU/PD/BI + cyber DSU; Lloyd's panel; risk engineering and cyber impact modelling.

ACAD-CLARKE-INDEX-DEMAND.title: A Theory of Rational Demand for Index Insurance
ACAD-CLARKE-INDEX-DEMAND.use: Downside basis risk r=P(loss∧no payout); explains low NDBI uptake; motivates trigger_gap scoring.

ACAD-LOPEZ-HYBRID.title: Combination of traditional and parametric insurance for heavy tail losses
ACAD-LOPEZ-HYBRID.use: Hybrid indemnity cap + parametric tail; maps to trigger_gap partial fill and product_fit tower structures.

REG-IAIS-PARAMETRIC.title: FSI Insights on parametric insurance
REG-IAIS-PARAMETRIC.use: Supervisory survey; basis risk as primary limitation; trigger transparency for data_monitoring.

ACAD-BOEHME-NONFIRM.authors: Boehme, T.; Harrison, G. P.; Wallace, A. R.
ACAD-BOEHME-NONFIRM.title: Assessment of Distribution Network Limits for Non-firm Connection of Renewable Generation
ACAD-BOEHME-NONFIRM.use: Foundational GB academic work on infirm/non-firm connections using OPF + time-series (not snapshot worst-case).; Quantifies curtailment frequency, duration, and economic loss — template for E[L] in pricing_modelling.; Orkney case study: firm connections over-state constraints; non-firm unlocks headroom at curtailment cost.

ACAD-CCM-NF-LOAD.authors: Mahuze, R.; Gressel, C.; Amadeh, A.; Zhang, K. M.
ACAD-CCM-NF-LOAD.title: The Potential Welfare Gains from Curtailment Trading Under Non-Firm Interconnection
ACAD-CCM-NF-LOAD.use: Explicitly models data centres accepting curtailment risk via non-firm interconnection for faster grid access.; VOLL heterogeneity ($4k–$667k/MWh) means pro-rata curtailment destroys surplus — basis for trigger_gap / parametric design.; Curtailment Credit Market achieves 1.41–1.83× welfare vs pro-rata — quantifies inefficiency of blunt allocation rules.

ACAD-DAMICO-WIND.authors: D'Amico, G.; Gismondi, F.; Petroni, F.
ACAD-DAMICO-WIND.title: Insurance Contracts for Hedging Wind Power Uncertainty
ACAD-DAMICO-WIND.use: Actuarial fair-premium calculation for wind-power revenue shortfall contracts; Joint copula/semi-Markov model captures correlation between generation and merchant price; Insurance contract exchanges cash flows when realized revenue falls below contracted floor

ACAD-DESANTI-FCA-QUEUE.authors: De Santi, F.; Meeus, L.; Beckstedde, E.; Delarue, E.; Vitiello, S.
ACAD-DESANTI-FCA-QUEUE.title: Managing Connection Queues in Distribution Networks with Flexible Connection Agreements
ACAD-DESANTI-FCA-QUEUE.use: EU-focused simulation of FCA curtailment rules (ProRata vs Technical Best) on synthetic DSO network.; Maximum curtailment capacity constraint (e.g. France 30% cap) improves fairness but rejects more queue entries.; Early queue entrants capture quasi-firm capacity — LIFO risk for later data-centre loads (aggregation_correlation).

ACAD-ELABED-MULTISCALE.authors: Elabed, G.; Bellemare, M. F.; Carter, M. R.; Guirkinger, C.
ACAD-ELABED-MULTISCALE.title: Managing basis risk with multiscale index insurance
ACAD-ELABED-MULTISCALE.use: Quantifies false-negative rate (FNR) as key basis-risk metric for index products; Multiscale contract: same premium, ~40% higher demand vs single-scale in Mali field data; Compound risk aversion further depresses index demand ~13pp beyond standard risk aversion

ACAD-EXPONENTIAL-PARETO-SLA-PREMIUM.title: Determination of Premium for Insurance Policies covering Long Outages in Cloud Services under the Exponential-Pareto Model
ACAD-EXPONENTIAL-PARETO-SLA-PREMIUM.use: Applies six standard actuarial premium principles (variance, Esscher, etc.) to SLA long-outage cover under Exponential-Pareto ON/OFF model (Naldi framework).; Long outages modelled as Poisson sum of Bernoulli indicators on outage duration threshold w — links SLA refund mechanics to claim frequency.; Explicitly motivated by CSP SLA refund obligations and insurer need to price tail long-outage risk without eroding capital.

ACAD-LICHTENBERG-TRIGGER.title: Index insurance and basis risk: A reconsideration
ACAD-LICHTENBERG-TRIGGER.use: Extends Clarke four-state model with farmer-chosen trigger level k; Optimal triggers target catastrophic tails even if downside basis risk r(k) rises; Explains why low uptake may reflect premium design, not insurmountable basis risk

ACAD-TEH-WOOLNOUGH-TRIGGER.title: A Better Trigger: Indices for Insurance
ACAD-TEH-WOOLNOUGH-TRIGGER.use: Separates upside basis risk q from downside basis risk r — higher correlation ≠ better index; Provides dominance ranking for binary and multivalue indices across heterogeneous buyers; Builds on Clarke (2016) viability condition for insurance purchase under basis risk

ACAD-WOODARD-BASIS.title: Basis risk and weather hedging effectiveness
ACAD-WOODARD-BASIS.use: Foundational empirical work on geographic basis risk in index-based risk transfer; Risk reduction improves as spatial aggregation of index and exposure increases; Temperature indices hedge more effectively than precipitation at distance

CEER-ACA-2023.title: Paper on Alternative Connection Agreements (C23-DS-83-06)
CEER-ACA-2023.use: Pan-EU survey: ACAs (non-firm/flexible/interruptible) used in 15+ member states with wide implementation variance.; ACAs as interim measure before reinforcement OR permanent where expansion uneconomic — maps to tenor_mismatch.; Compares ACA vs market-based flexibility procurement — DSO can choose when local markets immature.

INDUSTRY-AGGREGATION-CONUNDRUM.title: Data centres creating aggregation conundrum for insurers
INDUSTRY-AGGREGATION-CONUNDRUM.use: Concise UK insurance-media synthesis of S&P aggregation findings: PML vs MFL distinction and layered placement mechanics explained.; PML assumes partial safety-system impairment; MFL assumes total safeguard failure — drives very different limit structures.; Multiphase campus builds need dynamically stacked limits transitioning CAR → operational property — exposure evolves non-linearly.

INDUSTRY-PARAMETRIC-DC-FINANCING.authors: Insurance Business (interview: Marsh/Aon context; Preet Gill, Lockton)
INDUSTRY-PARAMETRIC-DC-FINANCING.title: How parametric insurance is helping data center projects get off the ground
INDUSTRY-PARAMETRIC-DC-FINANCING.use: Traditional BI ineffective for DC: 30-day waiting periods miss short SLA-triggering outages with large financial impact.; Parametric/SLA cover responds to voltage drops, defined downtime windows, rent/energy credits — micro-interruption focus.; Lenders increasingly require insurance or credit support backing contractual SLA obligations in project finance.

MARSH-NIMBUS-UK-LAUNCH.title: Marsh launches €1 billion insurance facility for large-scale data center construction in the UK and Europe
MARSH-NIMBUS-UK-LAUNCH.use: Original UK/Europe launch: up to €1bn CAR and €350m DSU via Lloyd's and European company markets.; Explicit UK focus — responds to regional DC build surge driven by cloud/AI processing demand.; Integrated CAR + DSU + PD + BI under single facility to streamline placement vs ad hoc London Market towers.

MARSH-UK-SLA-PARAMETRIC.authors: Marsh (UK Cyber Practice: Serena France-Hayhurst et al.)
MARSH-UK-SLA-PARAMETRIC.title: Cyber SLA Parametric Insurance for Data Centres — Insights paper
MARSH-UK-SLA-PARAMETRIC.use: UK-facing Marsh product framing SLA parametric cover for power, cooling, connectivity and tenant termination events.; Triggers tied to lease-agreement metrics (uptime %, power continuity); fixed payouts over predefined periods — not forensic BI adjustment.; Can be structured per facility or aggregated across a portfolio — relevant to London Market accumulation controls.

NESO-DEMAND-CFI.title: Demand Call for Input — Transmission-Level Demand Connection Queue
NESO-DEMAND-CFI.use: Primary evidence base for Ofgem demand reform; surveyed all transmission-level demand connection agreements.; Data centres dominate count and MW; clusters in T4 England & Wales, T11 England, T2 Scotland.; 81% appetite for alternative (phased/ramped/non-firm) arrangements — latent → measured if adopted as conditions.

NESO-GC0166.title: GC0166 Balancing Mechanism Parameters for Limited Duration Assets
NESO-GC0166.use: In force 5 Dec 2025; governs flexible/battery dispatch in BM.; Rules feed for L5 re-scoring when dispatch parameters change.; Maps to non_firm_intensity for limited-duration assets.

OFGEM-ACCESS-SCR.title: Access and Forward-Looking Charges Significant Code Review — Final Decision
OFGEM-ACCESS-SCR.use: Mandates standardised non-firm (curtailable) connection option for larger DNO users from April 2023.; Requires explicit curtailment limits and end-dates in connection offers — measurable contract fields.; Defines interruptible access: network can curtail import/export; trade-off is faster/cheaper connection.

PARAMETRIX-CLOUD-IN-A-BOX.title: Cloud-in-a-Box: Securitizing Cloud Outage Risk (ILS white paper)
PARAMETRIX-CLOUD-IN-A-BOX.use: Defines parametric cloud outage structures: waiting period, vendor, region, service bundle as modelled pricing variables.; Investor attractions: objective triggers, short tail, peril precision, diversification vs nat-cat — relevant to London ILS appetite.; Documents basis risk between index trigger and insured loss; outlines hypothetical transaction payouts.

SP-INSURANCE-GAP-HYPERSCALE.authors: S&P Global Ratings (Patricia Kwan; Charles-Marie Delpuech)
SP-INSURANCE-GAP-HYPERSCALE.title: The Insurance Gap Is Reshaping Hyperscale Data Center Finance
SP-INSURANCE-GAP-HYPERSCALE.use: Hyperscale campuses: $20bn–$50bn TIV at construction — beyond single-risk replacement-style capacity; coverage structured on PML/MFL not full value.; Insured portion often only one-third to one-half of campus value; remainder retained/self-insured by hyperscalers — gap persists at current scale.; Insurance gap functions as capital-structure constraint for lenders; tail risk migrating into balance sheets, captives and alt capital.

IND-VALUECHAIN.title: Insurance value chain — risk × distribution × pricing × balance sheet
IND-VALUECHAIN.use: Decomposition of the value chain; MGA (pricing without balance sheet), shared/layered towers, lineslips, binders; maps to book_concentration, capital_reinsurance, product_fit.

IND-BROKING.title: London broker market structure — placement and talent
IND-BROKING.use: Retail vs wholesale vs London chain; facility/binder economics; Marsh / Aon / WTW placement.

IND-BROKER-CHAIN.title: Broker chain — retail / wholesale / London
IND-BROKER-CHAIN.use: Three-layer broker chain; surplus lines; Howden / Ardonagh exclusive London facilities.

FIN-TRANCHING.title: Junior / senior claim tranching
FIN-TRANCHING.use: Shared-and-layered reinsurance towers; maps to aggregation_correlation under correlated tail events.

NESO-CONSTRAINT-COSTS.title: Balancing / constraint costs (Monthly Balancing Services Summary & data portal)
NESO-CONSTRAINT-COSTS.use: Curtailment / network-constraint cost as an observable proxy for non-firm interruption frequency and severity; supports the compound-loss view.

INDUSTRY-DC-COMPUTE-DEMAND.title: Electricity 2024 — Analysis and forecast to 2026 (data-centre & AI electricity demand)
INDUSTRY-DC-COMPUTE-DEMAND.use: Evidence that 24/7 AI/compute load is driving the demand surge and the value of firm, always-on power — the why-now behind non-firm risk.
